newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $17 bln 48-day cash bills Oct 31.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $17 bln 48-day cash bills Oct 31.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury said on Tuesday that it will auction $17 billion of 48-day cash management bills on Thursday, Oct 31.
The bills will be issued Nov 1 and will mature on Dec 19.
Minimum bids will be in amounts of $10,000.
Noncompetitive tenders will be accepted in full up to $1 million at the average discount rate of accepted competitive bids, which must be received by 1300 EDT (1700 GMT).
The CUSIP number for the bills will be 9127943S1.
